title: A Stranger on Reddit
author_note: First time talking to you. A complete stranger to me who I had no idea I’ll be talking till date. I remember vividly that I wrote this msg when I felt lonely and hurt. And I saw ur messages that you seemed lost too! I felt an unexplainable energy that I shld help u out. I remember I thought, at least make someone’s day better. Even if I won’t talk to them again. Little did I know that I’m talking to u till date after so many months.

messages.text: Don't mail them . . .just wait . . . I think they do it in terms of batches . . . I got mine on 19th and last date for slot booking was 22nd June for me, then some guy on reddit, he said he got it like 10 days late, around 24th June and had his slot booking till 9th July . . . Ig maybe you should wait. They probably send interview rejection emails . . . or maybe check your spam folder? idk . . . in case? Dw have hope buddy
Can't I just mail ? Like it won't hurt anybody

It'll sort of feel like you're needy but then after your post I searched up about the interview emails ppl got . . . and I'm sorry (and hope I'm wrong) but I saw some reddit posts saying that there r only two batches, one who got the email invite on 19th June and the other on 24th June . . . 💔 So then ig u can mail about it? It's upto you . . . do you have backup?

ohh I see . . . but then ik I'm a random stranger to you, but I feel don't lose hope bro. You still didn't get the rejection letter. Be delusional if you want. Also I searched up, Psych is the most competitive branch in ashoka and gets a lot of applications for it, so they need a lot of time to process. The fact that you still didn't get rejected means there is some hope. If they didn't like it, they wud prolly flat out send u the rejection mail . . . So don't lose hope brother . . . 🤞
even for me personally, I didn't even know abt ashoka until a month ago at all, js like other ppl I was preparing for JEE and competitive exams. And I am academically smart, thing is that 90% of my exams had system crashes last 10 mins and I lost all my options (UGEE I had 4 crashes). Especially BITS was my main goal and I solved around 110 . . . all went away . . . I cried as well. But I got to know about Ashoka and got to know it offers more flexibility for CS and combining other areas (for me I always wanted to combine both CS and Bio which a lot of clg don't offer) so . . . don't lose hope. I mean I still haven't had my interview for ashoka yet (it's on 29th), but I believe everything happens for a reason. If I hadn't gotten those sys crashes, I wudn't hv come here.
Lol idk why am I even putting so much effort to keep hope to a person idk . . . ig I js felt like it :))
